explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/782: 'It is a classical fact that the squares do not contain arithmetic progressions of length 4' (Fermat/Euler). The Lean variant states Set.IsAPOfLengthFree {n : ℕ | IsSquare n} 4, i.e. the set of natural squares (including 0) contains no non-trivial 4-term arithmetic progression (nonzero common difference). This is the classical theorem, which also holds with 0 included. Faithful.
